typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		{Published Location} as string,
		{Publish Date} as string,
		Modified as date,
		{Metric SME} as string,
		{Escalation Path} as string,
		{Data Points} as double,
		{Current Automation Status} as string,
		{Metric Name} as string,
		{Metric Definition} as string,
		{Report Name} as string,
		{Metric Classification} as string,
		{Link to Published Location} as string,
		{Metric Owner} as string,
		{Control ID} as string,
		{Published Frequency} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Status as string,
		PublishedLocation as string,
		PublishDate as string,
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MetricSME as string,
		EscalationPath as string,
		DataPoints as double,
		CurrentAutomationStatus as string,
		MetricName as string,
		MetricDefinition as string,
		ReportName as string,
		MetricClassification as string,
		LinkToPublishedLocation as string,
		MetricOwner as string,
		ControlID as string,
		PublishedFrequency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		PublishedLocation = {Published Location},
		PublishDate = {Publish Date},
		Modified,
		MetricSME = {Metric SME},
		EscalationPath = {Escalation Path},
		DataPoints = {Data Points},
		CurrentAutomationStatus = {Current Automation Status},
		MetricName = {Metric Name},
		MetricDefinition = {Metric Definition},
		ReportName = {Report Name},
		MetricClassification = {Metric Classification},
		LinkToPublishedLocation = {Link to Published Location},
		MetricOwner = {Metric Owner},
		ControlID = {Control ID},
		PublishedFrequency = {Published Frequency}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
